newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul to release 100 bln won on Hanbo.
newsitem.headline: Seoul to release 100 bln won on Hanbo.

text.p: South Korea plans to release 100 billion won by February 6 to keep Hanbo Steel Co running and to help firms hit by the steelmaker's financial failure, Finance and Economy Minister Han Seung-soo said on Friday.

The emergency fund supply is aimed at helping Hanbo pay for raw materials and transportation expenses. It would also be used to pay wages of Hanbo's suppliers and subcontractors, Han told a meeting of economy ministers.
Hanbo is seeking court receivership after it defaulted on debt repayments last Thursday.
